why: bands-1 (all exit 0 but the two Bl₂Px₃ groups, cut at the deadline): the calibration is in, our corundum's gap 6.02 eV at Γ against same-functional PySCF's 5.95 (the code within 0.06 eV), measured 8.8 (the functional 2.8 eV low). Both Bl₂Px₃ cells' SCFs converged (13 iterations) but the band path (29 k, 38 bands, a 1.35-million-point 4D grid) didn't finish, and nothing was kept. pwcheck bands now saves the SCF (eigenvalues, potential) the moment it's done and prints the SCF grid's band edges, then does a shorter path (halfway and all the way to each zone face and the far corner, occ + 4 bands) saving each point, so a cut run resumes.
